summary: Proposes regional registrations for Mobile IPv4. Normally a mobile node reports every change of care-of address to its home agent. Here a new entity, the Gateway Foreign Agent, handles registrations locally within the visited domain, which reduces signaling to the distant home network. It is an experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: If you move between rooms in a hotel, you tell the front desk instead of calling home every time. A local helper keeps track, so far-away people are bothered less.
